occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: The operation has not conducted routine fire drills for February-August.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: The operation has not conducted routine fire drills for February-July.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: At the time of inspection one caregiver was observed caring for 27 school age children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: The operation has not conducted routine fire drills for February-July. The operation was able to conduct a fire drill, but was unable to evacuate the building within 3 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Director present-Minimum 75%: This standard has been tasked as part of an investigation and is found to be deficient. The director has not been regularly present at the operation a minimum of 75 percent of the time or a minimum of 30 hours per week.  The operation was unable to provide attendance records for the center director to verify attendance.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director present-Minimum 75% (26 TAC §746.1011(a))

occurrences.finding: Caregiver Qualification Age Exemption Attends High School - Supervised By Qualified Caregiver: A caregiver under the age of 18 was observed caring for children unsupervised without a qualified caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Caregiver Qualification Age Exemption Attends High School - Supervised By Qualified Caregiver (26 TAC §746.1109(b)(2))

occurrences.finding: Caregiver Qualification Age Exemption Attends High School - Enrolled in Child-care Career Program Approved by TEA/TEPSAC: A caregiver under the age of 18 works with children and has not enrolled in or completed a child care career related program with their high school.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Caregiver Qualification Age Exemption Attends High School - Enrolled in Child-care Career Program Approved by TEA/TEPSAC (26 TAC §746.1109(b)(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Caregiver Qualification Age Exemption Attends High School - Supervised By Qualified Caregiver: A caregiver under the age of 18 was observed caring for children unsupervised without a qualified caregiver. This was corrected at inspection when the additional caregiver arrived.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Caregiver Qualification Age Exemption Attends High School - Supervised By Qualified Caregiver (26 TAC §746.1109(b)(2))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: This standard has been tasked as part of an investigation and is found to be deficient. The operation has not conducted routine fire drills for February-June.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Director present-Minimum 75%: This standard has been tasked as part of an investigation and is found to be deficient. The director has not been regularly present at the operation a minimum of 75 percent of the time or a minimum of 30 hours per week.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director present-Minimum 75% (26 TAC §746.1011(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985): This standard has been tasked as part of an investigation and is found to be deficient. Three personnel files reviewed had affidavits that were not notarized.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Parental Notification of Less Serious Injuries: This standard has been tasked as part of an investigation and is found to be deficient. The operation did not make a parent aware of an incident that required first-aid treatment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Notification of Less Serious Injuries (26 TAC §746.307(c))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: This standard has been tasked as part of an investigation and is found to be deficient. The caregiver left their assigned group of children unattended that resulted in a child sustaining an injury.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program: 2 children's files were missing health statements, while participating at the operation for more than one year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program (26 TAC §746.611(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: A child's file was missing an immunization document.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training: A staff's file was missing 16 hours of the required 24 hours of annual training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Waiver/Variance - Comply w/ each condition while in effect: The operation did not comply with the conditions of the wavier by allowing children under 5 years of age to use the soft contained play equipment.    This was corrected at inspection when the director removed the children under 5 years of age from using the soft contained play equipment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Waiver/Variance - Comply w/ each condition while in effect (26 TAC §745.8311(b))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Annual Sanitation Inspection: The operation did not have documentation of the most recent sanitation report.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3403)

occurrences.finding: Director present-Minimum 75%: The director did not have documentation to verify being present a minimum of 75 percent of the program's operating hours each week or a minimum of 30 hours per week.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director present-Minimum 75% (26 TAC §746.1011(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: 1 child's file was found missing an immunization record.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist: The operation does not have documentation verifying completion of the equipment being checked for the month of September.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist (26 TAC §746.4751(b))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: The operation does not have monthly drills ran since 4/5/2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: The operation was not current with their fire drills.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Review list and Remove unsafe products: The consumer product safety form was not current.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Review list and Remove unsafe products (26 TAC §746.4135(a))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The fire inspection was not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The health inspection was not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR: One employee did not have their Pediatric CPR and First Aid available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: A child received stitches on their finger after they placed their hand inside of a padding that covered a pole on the playscape.  The poles are covered by a padding and are secured by plastic lock ties.  There was an opening in the padding where the child was able to put their hand in.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Caregiver Qualification Age Exemption Attends High School - Enrolled in Child-care Career Program Approved by TEA/TEPSAC: This standard was tasked as part of an investigation and found deficient. A 17-year-old caregiver attending high school is not enrolled in and has not completed a child-care-related career program.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Caregiver Qualification Age Exemption Attends High School - Enrolled in Child-care Career Program Approved by TEA/TEPSAC (26 TAC §746.1109(b)(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children: Two toddlers were wandering alone in the operation on two different occasions.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Parental Notification of Less Serious Injuries: A child was hit with a ball by another student while in care. As a result of this, a tooth that was loose fell out. The child's mouth was bleeding and required an oral rinse. The parent was not notified of this incident.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Notification of Less Serious Injuries (26 TAC §746.307(c))

occurrences.finding: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Never Allow Toddlers to Sleep or Walk With Bottles and Training Cups: A 20 month old toddler was observed walking  around with a training cup and food.  This was corrected during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Never Allow Toddlers to Sleep or Walk With Bottles and Training Cups (26 TAC §746.2505(4)(C))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit: One caregiver files reviewed out of eight did not  documentation of affidavit. This was corrected  during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- signed dated statement that employee attended abuse/neglect training: Three caregiver files reviewed out of eight did not  documentation of completed orientation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Current Driver's License (26 TAC §746.901(10))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: A caregiver lacked 21 annual hours from the last  complete training year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required: The director lacked 30 annual hours from the last  complete training year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1311(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records-signed dated statement that employee received child care center's operational policies: Two staff files reviewed out of eight did not have  documentation signed center policies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records-signed dated statement that employee received child care center's operational policies (26 TAC §746.901(6)(A))

occurrences.finding: Parental Notification of Communicable Disease: The operation failed to notify parents of a positive COVID case. This was corrected during their inspection 11-29-21. A notice was posted on their operation door.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Notification of Communicable Disease (26 TAC §746.307(d))

occurrences.finding: Report Outbreak of Communicable Illness: The operation failed to notify child care regulation of a positive COVID case
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Outbreak of Communicable Illness (26 TAC §746.305(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers- Supervision of Children: The caregiver in charge fail to supervise when a two year old was locked inside a supply closet for seven minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: The staff failed to make sure an area that was accessible to children was free from hazards. A two year old had access to glitter unsupervised.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: The director has not ensured that the facility is operating in compliance with the minimum standards. The director failed to properly staff the operation to provide adequate supervision of the children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))
